name: Agent Launcher
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Agent Dashboard for Omarchy: create and launch AI agents (Hermes Agent, OpenClaw) locally, in Docker, or on a Fly.io Sprite; see every agent's status, jump to its chat, follow a sortable event log, and get notified when an agent needs you. Sessions persist in tmux.

barWidget.description: Bar button that opens the persistent Agent Dashboard (right click: quick agent switcher) with a badge when an agent needs you.
